item.title: Open call: Composition Award for women composers in Sweden
item.description: Allmänna Sången in Sweden has announced that submissions for the next Allmänna Sången & Anders Wall Composition Award (ASAWCA) will open in March, ahead of the award presentation in spring 2027. The international competition aims to support and highlight women composers and their contributions to choir music. The competition is open to women composers of any nationality, age, or professional background. Submissions must be unpublished and not previously performed. Compositions should be written

item.title: Menzi Music stays rooted in tradition on thoughtful Unamagqubu album
item.description: Menzi Music released his maskandi album Unamagqubu on 12 December 2025 through Menzi Music Production. Rooted in traditional guitar-driven arrangements and narrative-led songwriting, the album presents a focused exploration of personal experience and cultural identity within contemporary maskandi. Credited to Menzi Music, also known as Menzi Mabizela, Unamagqubu is marked by a strong sense of authenticity. item.title: Open call: National Arts Council support funding programme in SA
item.description: The National Arts Council (NAC) of South Africa has opened applications for its three-year Arts Organisation Support Funding, inviting registered arts organisations and companies to apply for sustained financial support. The funding is open to organisations operating within the disciplines of music, craft, dance, visual arts, literature, theatre and multi-disciplinary arts. Applicants are required to demonstrate how their proposed programmes or projects align with the NAC’s critical focus areas

item.title: Nigerian music executive Bugwu Aneto-Okeke joins global Merlin board
item.description: Merlin, the global digital music licensing partner for independent labels and distributors, has announced its 2026 Board, bringing together leaders from 12 countries across Africa, Asia, Europe, Latin America, North America, and Oceania. Among the newly elected members is Nigerian music executive Bugwu Aneto-Okeke of Measurable Accurate Digital Solutions (M.A.D Solutions), highlighting Africa’s growing influence in the independent music sector. item.title: Calum Scott returns to SA with Avenoir tour as Cape Town show sells out
item.description: British singer and songwriter Calum Scott has returned to South Africa as part of his global Avenoir Tour, with performances scheduled in Cape Town, Durban and Pretoria. The Cape Town concert, set for 14 January, has sold out, while limited tickets remain available for the Durban show on 16 January and Pretoria on 17 January. item.title: Universal Music Group appoints Hannah Poferl as chief data officer
item.description: Universal Music Group (UMG) has appointed Hannah Poferl as its chief data officer, with immediate effect. She will be based in Santa Monica and report to the company’s chief operating officer, Boyd Muir. Poferl joins UMG from The New York Times, where she spent nearly 12 years in senior editorial and data leadership roles. item.description: The European Commission has launched the 2026 Erasmus+ Call for Proposals, opening access to funding for organisations and institutions involved in education, training, youth and sport. item.title: Open call: 2026 UNESCO funding
item.description: UNESCO is inviting national authorities and civil society organisations to submit proposals aimed at strengthening the status of artists and promoting artistic freedom, in line with the 2005 Convention on the Protection and Promotion of the Diversity of Cultural Expressions. item.title: Open call: Thought pieces on cultural exchange
item.description: The Goethe-Institut has issued an open call for proposals inviting contributions that critically examine the concept of ‘cultural exchange’, with a particular focus on its use within Africa–Europe cultural cooperation. item.title: Tanzania: Abigail Chams drops Your Loss single, announces Visa partnership
item.description: Tanzanian artist Abigail Chams has released her first single of the year, ‘Your Loss’, accompanied by an official music video and the announcement of a new partnership with Visa.
